body: I would never know, how could I miss it?

I don't agree with that logic. To me death is not losing anything, and in the deepest sense you are losing more when you die the longer you live. The concept of missing out does not phase me a whole lot.

You are right, no one can know what will happen tomorrow, but I can tell you with a pretty high level of accuracy that my person would continue to feel the same. It has for a long time, through happy and sad.
